Congratulations to Gulf Coast State College on being recognized by U.S. Veterans Magazine and Military Times for its commitment to supporting veterans and military-connected students!

Northwest Florida has a proud military tradition, and I'm grateful to see our local

Veterans Day is deeply personal to me.

Having worn the uniform and served alongside some of the finest men and women this country has to offer, I know that service is more than a commitment — it’s a bond that stays with you for life.

Today, I think about those I had the privilege of serving with, the sacrifices made by our military families, and the brothers and sisters in arms who are no longer with us.

I’m proud to be a veteran, but even prouder to stand among those who answered the call to serve something greater than themselves.

To my fellow veterans, thank you for your service, your friendship, and your sacrifice. It is an honor to be counted among you.

God bless our veterans, their families, and the United States of America.

Happy 251st birthday to the @USMC! For generations, Marines have answered our nation’s call with courage and an unwavering commitment to freedom. To every Marine, past and present, and the families who stand beside you—thank you. Semper Fi! https://t.co/irqn3bXXW9
Read more: https://t.co/U55u2vy474

Northwest Florida has a proud tradition of standing with those who served. This past weekend, Bay County came together for Salute on the Shore, supporting Warrior Beach Retreat and the combat-wounded veterans and families it serves. Thank you to everyone who made this special

My team joined Ducks Unlimited at St. Marks National Wildlife Refuge to celebrate the conservation of more than 1,300 acres of Northwest Florida’s natural landscape!

These lands protect vital wetlands, support wildlife, and help safeguard our communities from flooding.

Preserving Northwest Florida’s natural beauty and outdoor heritage for future generations remains a priority!
Read more: https://t.co/1rY0H0C1nO

A strong, reliable medical supply chain is essential to protecting the American people. We cannot afford to depend on foreign adversaries for critical medicines and medical countermeasures. I applaud HHS and ASPR for their efforts to strengthen domestic supply chains and look forward to continuing our work to bolster America’s biodefense capabilities and ensure our nation is ready to respond to future threats.
Read more: https://t.co/dt1kfIqbx3

Great news for Northwest Florida! @FloridaState has received a $2.5 million NIH grant to study how our brains process taste and how that research could help Americans make healthier dietary choices.

This investment supports cutting-edge research right here in our district while advancing discoveries that could improve the health and well-being of our communities.

As a physician, I know how important it is to ensure patients with rare diseases have access to innovative treatments and quality care. I applaud CMS for recognizing the importance of advancing treatment options for sickle cell disease.

That is why I am proud to lead the bipartisan Sickle Cell Disease Comprehensive Care Act (H.R. 5178) alongside Rep. Danny Davis. Our legislation would expand access to coordinated, comprehensive care for patients living with sickle cell disease, helping improve health outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.
Read more: https://t.co/nV1qW179ZR

As a physician and a veteran, I am deeply concerned any decision to partner with China’s WuXi Biologics. We cannot afford to deepen our reliance on China for critical medicines. America’s pharmaceutical supply chain is a matter of national security.
Read more: https://t.co/RGWsUyA2aa

Northwest Florida has seen its share of severe weather, and yesterday's flooding in Bay County is another reminder of the importance of staying vigilant.

Never attempt to drive through floodwaters, and please heed the guidance of our local first responders.
See more here: https://t.co/5PS02tkVIQ

What a wonderful way to honor our veterans!

Six local veterans took to the skies over Tallahassee aboard historic World War II-era aircraft.

As an Army veteran, I’m grateful to see our communities recognizing the men and women who have served our nation.

Thank you for your service!

Great news for Northwest Florida!

President Trump has approved a major disaster declaration following Hurricane Isaias, providing federal assistance to help 15 counties recover and rebuild.

While Individual Assistance for impacted families remains under review, this is an important step forward in our recovery. My team and I stand ready to assist our communities.

My team had a great evening joining PanCare of Florida, Inc. at the FSU Panama City Annual Dinner. This event highlights FSU's impact in our community. 

It has been a privilege to work alongside FSU and PanCare throughout my time in Congress. 

I am proud of what we have accomplished together to strengthen access to quality healthcare for families across Northwest Florida!
See more: https://t.co/xzBYy9lccJ

After Hurricane Michael, Northwest Florida experienced firsthand the generosity of neighbors helping neighbors.

Now, Bay County students and educators are paying that kindness forward by collecting supplies for families impacted by Hurricane Isaias.

See more here: https://t.co/vpC3PMKxAR

Thank you to the Down Syndrome Association of the Emerald Coast, participating families, and volunteers for celebrating individuals with Down syndrome and supporting opportunities for all.

My prayers are with the victims, their families, and the entire FAMU community. I am grateful to our first responders and law

Great to see the new A.D. Harris Community Resilience Center open in Panama City, connecting families with critical resources and support when they need it most.

Thank you to the community partners and volunteers making this possible!
Read more here: https://t.co/9Iu4lfuFbN

Americans deserve the freedom to choose where they have their vehicles repaired without being forced into costly

I was proud to join Senator @SenAshleyMoody and my Florida colleagues in urging President Trump to approve the request from @GovRonDeSantis for a Major Disaster Declaration.

As Northwest Florida continues to recover, I remain committed to ensuring our communities have the federal resources they need to recover and rebuild.

Our farmers are the backbone of Northwest Florida, and we must ensure they have the resources they need to recover from Hurricane Isaias.

Thank you to Commissioner Wilton Simpson and @FDACS for launching this loan program to support Florida’s agricultural community.

Learn more: https://t.co/0WnCT8Y57R

As Northwest Florida begins recovering from Hurricane Isaias, many of our neighbors are looking for ways to lend a helping hand.

If you are able to volunteer or donate, I encourage you to connect with trusted organizations working directly in impacted communities.

Northwest Floridians have always stepped up for one another in times of need, and I know this time will be no different.

I want to once again express my sincere gratitude to the first responders and volunteers who continue to work tirelessly to help our communities recover. Your dedication and willingness to serve embody the very best of Northwest Florida.

I also want to thank the brave men and women who continue to answer the call to serve our nation, both here at home and abroad. We are grateful for your service and sacrifice.

As Northwest Florida begins assessing the damage from Hurricane Isaias, it’s important to know the steps to take to protect your home and property.

Document damage, contact your insurance provider, and be cautious of potential scams. https://t.co/x6qAX3RedF

For Bay County Residents - Fire/EMS Response Limited. Due to dangerous conditions, fire and EMS response countywide is limited to structure fires with entrapments and other life threatening emergencies. Lynn Haven Fire Rescue has suspended all responses. Law enforcement continues to respond countywide as conditions allow. Stay indoors and off roads. Call 911 for emergencies. Expect delays.

If you are evacuating ahead of Hurricane Isaias, transportation should not be a barrier to getting to safety.

Florida has partnered with Uber to provide free rides, up to $40 each way, to and from state-approved shelters.

Use promo code ISAIAS26 in the Uber app.

Find a shelter: https://t.co/ALZ5jY1wfp

Hurricane Isaias is now a Category 3 storm, with landfall expected later this evening.

Northwest Florida residents should prepare for dangerous winds, flash flooding, tornadoes, and life-threatening storm surge. Please take this storm seriously, follow local emergency officials, and get to a safe location NOW.

For more:  https://t.co/OAwnSO0sxl

Florida’s price gouging law is now in effect under the state of emergency.

As Floridians prepare for Hurricane Isaias, no one should have to face unfair prices for essential supplies.

If you suspect price gouging on gas, food, lodging, or emergency supplies, report it to the Florida Attorney General’s Office at 1-866-966-7226.

Stay safe, Northwest Florida.

As Hurricane Isaias approaches Northwest Florida, staying informed is critical.

I encourage everyone to download the FEMA app for real-time weather alerts, emergency shelter locations, and preparedness resources.

Take a few minutes now to prepare and keep your family safe.

https://t.co/Z9H04fLOBH

Thank you to the brave men and women of the @FLGuard for standing ready to support our communities as Hurricane Isaias approaches.

Your service and dedication to keeping Floridians safe are deeply appreciated. We are grateful to have you ready to respond when Northwest Florida needs you most.

As Hurricane Isaias approaches Northwest Florida, I urge all residents to know your evacuation zone and have a plan in place.

Knowing your zone can make all the difference when severe weather strikes. Please follow guidance from local officials and heed evacuation orders.

Check your zone here: https://t.co/LJYzjmk0r5

If you or your family need a safe place to stay as Hurricane Isaias approaches, the American Red Cross can help you find an open emergency shelter.

Please don’t wait until conditions become dangerous. Follow guidance from local emergency officials and make a plan to get to safety.

Find a shelter near you: https://t.co/FR4OUOF8e7

Stay safe, Northwest Florida.

Hurricane Isaias is strengthening as it approaches the Gulf Coast, and Northwest Florida needs to be ready.

With dangerous winds, flooding, and storm surge possible, now is the time to finish preparations. Know your evacuation zone, have emergency supplies ready, and heed local warnings.

Your family’s safety comes first.
https://t.co/qbEZyPx6vE

Florida knows the importance of being prepared. As Tropical Depression Nine develops, I encourage everyone across Northwest Florida to stay alert, monitor local guidance, and make sure your family has a plan in place.

My team and I are closely monitoring the storm and stand ready to assist our communities as needed.

Small businesses are the backbone of our communities and create opportunities across Northwest Florida. The SBA is accepting nominations for its 2027 National Small Business Week awards. Nominate a local business at https://t.co/VfYzeWbR4m. https://t.co/Cvggk8Vww1

As a physician, I know preparedness matters before a crisis strikes. Recent findings on high-risk lab equipment underscore the need to strengthen our defenses against biological threats. Reauthorizing PAHPA will help ensure our public health system and medical countermeasures are ready to protect Americans.
Read more: https://t.co/iFKGyMlZSy

Our team was proud to join Second Harvest of the Big Bend for the grand opening of its new facility last week. 

Serving 16 counties, Second Harvest distributed 18.9 million pounds of food last year—the equivalent of 15.7 million meals.

This new facility will expand its capacity and bring Second Harvest closer to ensuring every family in the region has access to nutritious food.

Independent auto dealers are in Washington this week with a clear message: Americans deserve the right to repair the vehicles they own.

Proud to see support for my REPAIR Act as we continue working to secure meaningful right-to-repair protections in surface transportation reauthorization.

If you own your car, you should own its data.

Americans are already paying too much for prescription drugs. We shouldn’t allow practices to drive costs even higher or stand between patients and the medications they need.

This week, I introduced the Patients Access to Specialty Pharmacy Act. It aims to increase competition and give patients greater choice in where they receive their specialty medications — regardless of a pharmacy’s affiliation with an insurer.

More competition. More choice. Lower costs for American families.
